This file contains your passwords in plain text. Store it somewhere safe.
The selected document provider controls where the plaintext file is stored and may offer remote locations.
Spreadsheet apps may interpret values as formulas or change formatting. Keeppeer preserves backup values exactly; quoting does not prevent formula interpretation.
Read and validate the selected CSV in this unlocked session? No entries change until you confirm the duplicate policy.

Matches use exact title and username (empty username equals absent). Update targets the lowest existing local ID. Rows apply in file order; later matching rows update that same target. Other existing matches remain.
The vault changed. Review these refreshed counts and choose a policy again.
CSV export finished. Protect the plaintext file separately.

Export interrupted or unavailable. A partial plaintext document may remain. Keeppeer attempts deletion only for its newly created document; check the selected provider. Deletion and secure erasure cannot be guaranteed.
CSV work cancelled. An import already committed may still have completed. An interrupted export may leave plaintext at the selected provider; check and remove it if needed.
Selection or approval expired. Unlock if needed and select the document again. No old operation will restart automatically.
CSV operation failed (input, provider, vault or limit error). No partial import was committed. Select the file again to retry.
You can export a CSV backup in Security settings before changing your password. Export is optional; plaintext exports need separate protection.
Your vault is encrypted on this phone. Unlock to see your passwords.
Offline vault. No account, no sync.
Set one master password. It is the only key to this vault.
Locks as soon as you leave.
